notes.title: Sounds, Achievements and Loops Update (v 1.1)
notes.notes:
This is a big update introducing sound, achievements and even loops as a form of freeplay.

[h3]LOOPS[/h3]
After beating the game, there is a Loops button in the end screen.
After pressing it, the game continues infinitely.
Waves have a prefix L, indicating Loops.
New growth formulas stop spawning in Loops.
Each wave gets progressively harder, forever.

[h3]ACHIEVEMENTS[/h3]
Achievements have been added to steam.
You can try getting them if you want.
For more info check the achievements page of the game through the library.

[h3]SOUNDS[/h3]
You are not deaf anymore!
Added volume slider in the pause menu.
Added a bunch of diffirent sounds.
Continous: Core buzzing and player walking.
One-time: Pistol shot, tower shot, bug screeches and others.

[h3]MINOR CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Credits
[*] Boss stops the next day from starting until he is dead
[/list]

I dont think I will continue updating this game.
At least not in the near time.
From now on Plant the Towers is on its own.
Thank you for buying this game and see you soon!

notes.title: Tutorial Update + Small QOL (v 1.0.1)
notes.notes:
A long awaited update that fixes some bugs and renovates the tutorial.

[h3]TUTORIAL[/h3]
Tutorial was updated and mechanics are explained better.
Added text with translations.
The tutorial should explain the game better now.

[h3]BUGFIX[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added sprites for Boss and Centipides
[*] Fixed bug with negative crops
[/list]

[h3]NEW EFFECTS[/h3]
Added effect of player damage and fog near the map borders.
Added plant effect to know when it reached the final stage.

[h3]QOL[/h3]
Added version number and tutorial recommendation in main menu.
Added wave counter.
Fixed shovel range and yellow bug range.
Added death screen and win screen.
Added pause.

Some balance changes...

The next update will finally include sound effects and some achievements.
And i will also make a new trailer and update the store page.
